title: Universe classifier axes record v0.4.0
description: ADR-132. Successor to universe_classifier_axes_record@0.3.0, and the first change to what the model is asked to produce rather than how much of it. The free-text quote is REMOVED. Through V2.4 the model typed the evidence quote, and three live calibrations showed the cost: of ten diagnosed quote failures, one dropped an invisible U+200B, four were small visible copy errors, two spliced spans thousands of characters apart, one attributed a correctly copied quote to the wrong passage, and one composed roughly 45% of its own text. Five failure classes, all downstream of letting a model type characters that are meant to be a copy. Here the model instead selects span_ref, naming a contiguous run of whole sentence units the pinned span index derived from the hash-bound packet, and the pipeline retrieves the text. Four of the five classes become structurally unreachable; the fifth, selecting the wrong span, still yields authentic packet text attached to a claim, which is a judgement a human reviewer can make and not fabricated evidence. passage_ref is retained beside span_ref even though the span reference carries its own prefix: an item whose two references disagree is a different defect from one naming an undisplayed passage, and a reader deserves to be told which. additionalProperties is false, so a V2.4 response carrying a quote is refused here and a V2.5 response carrying span_ref is refused by 0.3.0 -- the rejection is bidirectional and structural, unlike the 0.2.0-to-0.3.0 widening. Every axis, enum value, tier rule and the 12-object evidence ceiling are byte-equivalent to 0.3.0; supported_claim keeps its 300-character bound. ADR-126. Exactly what the model returns for one firm: economic axes and the evidence for them. There is deliberately no tier field of any name. A tier is derived afterwards by a versioned deterministic engine from these axes, so a prompt revision can never silently move tier membership, and a model that emits a tier is refused rather than obeyed.

customer_market_orientation.description: Descriptive metadata only. The deterministic tier engine takes this as no input at all.

contradictions.description: Where the complete Item 1 packet qualifies or contradicts the non-authoritative admission context.

span_ref.description: A contiguous run of whole sentence units inside one displayed passage, named by the pinned span index. Pnnn:Snnn selects one unit; Pnnn:Snnn-Snnn selects a run in reading order. The model returns this identifier and no source text.
